verdictEs: NMS Coordinate Exchange (NMSCE) si buscas algo específico — exotic ship S-class, multi-tool con stats target, base community shareable. NMS Galactic Atlas si quieres contexto visual del universo, ver qué expedition está activa o navegar discoveries sin un objetivo concreto.
verdictEn: NMS Coordinate Exchange (NMSCE) for directed searches — S-class exotic ship, multi-tool with target stats, shareable community base. NMS Galactic Atlas for visual context of the universe, seeing which expedition is active, or browsing discoveries without a specific goal.

useCases.labelEs: Encontrar las coords exactas de un exotic ship S-class
useCases.labelEn: Find exact coords for an S-class exotic ship
useCases.reasonEs: NMSCE tiene filtros específicos por ship class, exotic vs hauler, S-class only. Galactic Atlas no expone filtros granulares — fue diseñado como showcase visual, no como search engine.
useCases.reasonEn: NMSCE has specific filters by ship class, exotic vs hauler, S-class only. Galactic Atlas doesn't expose granular filters — it was designed as visual showcase, not as search engine.

useCases.labelEs: Ver qué expedition está activa este mes
useCases.labelEn: See which expedition is active this month
useCases.reasonEs: Galactic Atlas integra el live state de expeditions — Hello Games lo updates oficialmente. NMSCE es community-driven y no cubre expeditions oficiales del developer.
useCases.reasonEn: Galactic Atlas integrates the live state of expeditions — Hello Games updates it officially. NMSCE is community-driven and doesn't cover the developer's official expeditions.

useCases.labelEs: Buscar una mega-base community-built para visitar
useCases.labelEn: Search for a community-built mega-base to visit
useCases.reasonEs: NMSCE tiene una sección dedicada a bases con coords portal, screenshots y descripciones. Galactic Atlas no permite browsing de bases — solo planets y missions.
useCases.reasonEn: NMSCE has a dedicated section for bases with portal coords, screenshots, and descriptions. Galactic Atlas doesn't allow base browsing — only planets and missions.

useCases.labelEs: Visualizar la escala del universo y la distribución de galaxies
useCases.labelEn: Visualize the universe scale and galaxy distribution
useCases.reasonEs: Galactic Atlas es un visual showcase de todas las 256 galaxies y los discoveries reportados oficialmente. NMSCE es text-based y no proyecta visualización espacial.
useCases.reasonEn: Galactic Atlas is a visual showcase of all 256 galaxies and officially reported discoveries. NMSCE is text-based and doesn't render spatial visualization.

useCases.labelEs: Verificar que una coord sigue válida tras un patch que regeneró el universo
useCases.labelEn: Verify a coord is still valid after a universe-regenerating patch
useCases.reasonEs: NMSCE tiene comments y reports de community sobre entries — players reportan si las coords todavía funcionan post-patch. Galactic Atlas no tiene esta capa social.
useCases.reasonEn: NMSCE has community comments and reports on entries — players report whether coords still work post-patch. Galactic Atlas doesn't have this social layer.
